_description: Field offset overrides for structs where TAUDT_FIXED cannot create the struct (too large, too sparse).
_notes: These offsets have binary evidence from function analysis.
Codegen uses this to rewrite (char*)this + N -> this->field.
Does NOT use TAUDT_FIXED — bypasses IDA struct creation limits.

MainPropUI.class_hint: Struct that embeds RenderTarget at offset 0. RenderTarget::OnRender operates on this struct.

CCBStage.class_hint: Struct that embeds CCBProtectWindow at offset 0. OnMessage operates on this struct.
